title: Bristol Shotgun Range
specs: Enclosed heated 5-Stand building with viewing room
Wireless microphones and pullers for trap shooting
Minimum shotgun barrel length 24 inches; no home defense guns
Only #7½, #8, #9 shot allowed with max 1300 fps on trap and 5-stand; only #9 shot max 1200 fps on skeet
Shooters must wear ear and eye protection on the fields
Youth non-members 17 and younger shoot at member prices
Large or special event groups welcome; call ahead to discuss
includes: Range Safety Officer guidance for new shooters
Use of wireless microphones and pullers for trap shooting
gap: Duration for skeet and 5-Stand rounds not stated
blurb: Bristol Shotgun Range offers 4 trap fields, 1 skeet field, and an enclosed heated 5-Stand building with viewing room. Range Safety Officers assist new shooters. The range is open Friday to Sunday with a climate controlled clubhouse and restrooms.
extraNote: Reservations not taken unless group larger than 5 · Alcohol and drugs prohibited on range; intoxicated persons will be asked to leave · No shooting with game loads, steel shot, or slugs; target loads only · No pets allowed on range · Smoking only in designated area · Check in at the clubhouse cashier counter · Year round
